policy_paths.selection_information: proxy reward and frozen path parameters only; hidden true-error values are unavailable

comparators.proxy_only: proxy_gain > 0; intentionally invalid as a safety certificate
comparators.rmse_only: proxy_gain - delta_2 > 0; intentionally omits policy movement
comparators.pinsker: proxy_gain - sqrt(2 KL(pi||p0)) > 0 under the declared unit sup-norm cap
comparators.registered: maximum of the three simultaneously valid dual lower bounds

primary_outputs: simultaneous norm-bound failure rate and one-sided exact binomial upper bound
false-safe count conditional on valid norm bounds
certified true-positive fraction by error family, sample size, and optimizer path
risk-coverage curve using the registered lower-bound margin
rare-tail false-safe comparison against proxy-only and RMSE-only

gates.G0_registration_binding: Claim packet, prior art, protocol, implementation, tests, verifier, and README are committed and hash-bound before execution.
gates.G1_calibration_coverage: For every error-family/sample-size condition, the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on simultaneous norm-bound failure is at most 0.06.
gates.G2_certificate_soundness: There are zero positive registered certificates with non-positive true gain when both sampled norm bounds are valid.
gates.G3_nonvacuity: At m=512 on diffuse_low_error, at least 10% of truly positive policy/replicate cells receive a positive registered certificate.
gates.G4_stronger_than_pinsker: At m=512 on diffuse_low_error, the registered certified true-positive fraction exceeds the Pinsker comparator by at least 0.10.
gates.G5_optimizer_transfer: At m=512 on diffuse_low_error, every registered optimizer family has at least one policy certified in at least 50% of replicates, without family-specific refitting.
gates.G6_rare_tail_liveness: On rare_top_tail, proxy-only and RMSE-only each produce at least one false-safe policy/replicate cell, while G2 remains satisfied.
gates.G7_sample_size_ordering: Within each error family, mean registered certification coverage is nondecreasing across m=32,128,512.
gates.G8_resources_and_receipts: The run stays within registered CPU/RAM ceilings and emits write-once result, summaries, risk curve, report, and receipt artifacts.

decision_rule.valid_but_vacuous: G0, G1, G2, G6, G7, and G8 pass but G3, G4, or G5 fails
decision_rule.not_established: Any of G1, G2, G6, or G7 fails while registration and receipts remain valid

claim_boundary: Synthetic finite-population calibration of a classical robust lower bound; no learned reward model, no real human-preference uncertainty set, no RL trajectory, and no ASMP-8 resolution.
